test_type: Exploratory ablation, original production headless runtime, fixed official excerpts, real Gemma4 12B inference
source_verification: passed before each inference and after final inference
grading: Independent code-agent review against preregistered requirements; tested Gemma model did not grade itself. Formal binding is separate from sentence support and knowledge semantics.
limitations: Two seeds on five tasks; no statistical noninferiority claim.
Frozen single-source excerpts; no autonomous search ranking, long omitted windows, or competing multi-source versions. WAL checkpoint/rewind not covered.
Warm data are explicit legal-ID fixtures, not knowledge accumulated by the tested model. IDs contain multiple hyphens; do not estimate production failure frequency from this fixture.

Independent fresh stores use production-random owner IDs and live retrieved timestamps; no byte-identical-request causal claim for semantic score differences. Task/material/sampling/budgets and code ablation were frozen.
No stored-knowledge edit task: no claim that knowledge_commit is globally unnecessary.
Failed delivery has no assessable final report, not proof all facts were wrong.

decision.dedup_rules: Not approved for production removal: cold input -5.02%, overall retries erase savings; paired content omissions persist.
decision.hide_revision: Not approved for production removal: cold input savings, but warm delivery regresses and total input/calls increase. Do not remove stored-knowledge editing implementation.
decision.no_auto_recall: Retain automatic recall: disabling it does not improve the measured outcomes; explicit lookup still fails and total cost grows.
decision.retained: Original task; actual evidence read/windows; whole answer; knowledge_updates; exact IDs/versions/scope/citation checks; atomic publication; cancellation/recovery; retry stopping.
decision.next_review_focus: Historical target selection/copying and preservation of semantic conditions. Do not silently equate hyphen and underscore identities or remove exact-version checks.
